City Pop - Cosy Studio Apartments just next to HB Zürich

Neu eröffnet! Ab dem 20.03.2025 bieten wir zentral gelegene Apartments im Gebäude City Pop Zurich City an der Militarstrasse 106, 8004 Zürich an, die zwischen 19 und 46 Quadratmeter groß sind. Ab 510 CHF/Woche können Sie aus verschiedenen Pop-Typen wählen: S, M, L, 2.5.Die beigefügten Bilder stammen aus anderen City Pop Apartments und sind als repräsentativ zu betrachten. Da die Bauarbeiten noch im Gange sind, stehen uns noch keine Originalfotos zur Verfügung.So buchen Sie Ihr Apartment:Laden Sie einfach unsere App herunter: • Für iOS: Suchen Sie nach City Pop im App Store. • Für Android: Suchen Sie nach City Pop im Google Play Store. First rental: Fantastic 3.5 maisonette apartments with private roof terrace

The property at Seefeldstrasse 26, 28, 32, 34 is located in the heart of one of Zurich's most attractive residential areas - Seefeld. Just a few steps from Lake Zurich, residents here enjoy a unique combination of urban lifestyle, high quality of life, and natural recreation. Thanks to its central location in District 8, you benefit from an excellent infrastructure and optimal transport connections. Stadelhofen station, various tram lines, and bus connections are within walking distance and connect you to the city center, Zurich Airport, and the entire agglomeration in no time. On the completely renovated building, a new attic floor was created with attractive 2-story maisonette apartments with private roof terraces. The individual apartments already have a small terrace on the lower floor. The bedrooms and bathrooms, which are arranged here, benefit from a normal room height without sloping ceilings, allowing for the placement of cabinets. An internal staircase leads to the upper floor, where the attractive sloping ceiling houses the kitchen and living/dining area. Another internal staircase leads to the roof and the private roof garden. The view over the roofs of Seefeld is fantastic. In sunny weather, the seating area can be shaded by a pergola. Enjoy a drink and an aperitif while taking in life above the roofs of Zurich. Living on Seefeldstrasse means living in the heart of Zurich while still enjoying the luxury of peace, nature, and lake access right outside your door.
